name: Excalibur
specialEffects: Can be gifted to the hero by dipping a long sword in a fountain at XL 5+ as lawful (1/6 chance for Knight, 1/30 for other lawfuls).
Can be wielded by any lawful character without blast damage as long as their alignment record is above 0.
Sword enchantment (up to +5) affects manual search chance.
Lawful demon princes cannot be bribed while wielding Excalibur and become immediately hostile.
Monsters can always track the hero while wielded (not a huge effect).

name: Stormbringer
specialEffects: Drains 1 level and target max HP from non-drain-resistant enemies on hit.
Instantly kills level 1 or level 0 enemies when drained.
Heals the wielder for half of the drained HP.
Bloodthirsty: attacks pets/peacefuls instead of displacing them.

name: Mjollnir
specialEffects: Can be thrown while wielded if wielder has 25 Strength.
Only returns to the thrower if thrown by a Valkyrie (~99% return, ~99% catch).
Failing to catch a returning throw deals damage and can destroy inventory rings and wands.
Does NOT confer shock resistance to the wielder.
Magically too heavy to kick more than 1 space.

name: Cleaver
specialEffects: Cleave attack: strikes up to three adjacent monsters simultaneously (target plus both flanking tiles).
Alternates swing direction (clockwise and counter-clockwise) on consecutive attacks.
First sacrifice gift for Barbarians.
Cannot cleave while engulfed/swallowed or in two-weapon combat (two-handed).

name: Grimtooth
specialEffects: Glows red in warning when elves are nearby.
Blade is permanently poisoned (poison never wears off).
On top of doing blast damage to non-chaotics, Elves will also be blasted.
Invoking flings blinding venom or acid venom (50/50 chance); bypasses cooldown for 25 Pw.
Cannot be gifted at altars to characters whose race is hostile to orcs (e.g. Elves).

name: Orcrist
specialEffects: Glows light blue in warning when orcs are nearby.
Safe for any alignment to touch and wield without blast damage UNLESS they're an orc.
Naturally rustproof and acidproof (crafted from elven wood).
Generates with base enchantment of +3; will not be gifted at altars to races hostile to elves (e.g. Orcs).

name: Sting
specialEffects: Instantly cuts through webs when trapped in a web or untrapping adjacent web tiles.
Glows light blue in warning when orcs are nearby.
Safe for any alignment to touch and wield without blast damage.
Naturally rustproof and acidproof (crafted from elven wood).
Generates with base enchantment of +2; will not be gifted at altars to races hostile to elves (e.g. Orcs).

name: Magicbane
specialEffects: Has a 40% chance on any hit to trigger one of four escalating magical tiers with bonus physical damage: Probe (+1d4 dmg), Stun (+2d4 dmg), Scare (+3d4 dmg, flees 3 turns), or Cancel (+4d4 dmg).
If initial MR check succeeds, special chances drop by 5% and stun odds decrease. Cancel and Scare allow a secondary MR check to prevent the status effect.
Bonus physical damage ALWAYS applies in full even if the monster resists magic.
Probing occurs if all other magical tiers don't trigger and passes a check (100% at +0, 1 in 3*spe if enchanted).
8.3% (or a 1/12) chance for confusion on any hit.
Canceling a spellcaster permanently grants +1 max Pw and restores 1 Pw.
Enchantment reduces magical attack rates (Cancel: 10% at <= +2, 5% at +3 to +5, 0% at +6+; Scare: 10% at <=+2, 5% at +3+).
Absorbs curses 95% of the time from any source (thrones, curse items monster spell, etc.) if wielded.
Suffers extra d4 damage from anti-magic traps if wielded.

name: Frost Brand
specialEffects: 25% chance on hit to freeze and shatter potions in target inventory, dealing extra blast damage.
Invoking cone of cold at Expert level.
Safe for any alignment to touch and wield without blast damage.

name: Fire Brand
specialEffects: 25% chance on hit to burn scrolls/books and explode potions in target inventory, dealing extra blast damage and igniting items.
Invoking casts fireball at Expert level.
Burns through webs instantly with 100% success rate when trapped or clearing adjacent webs.
Safe for any alignment to touch and wield without blast damage.
Burns away Slimed status if hit by it.

name: Dragonbane
specialEffects: Safe for any alignment to touch and wield without blast damage.
Generates with base +2 enchantment.

name: Demonbane
specialEffects: Invoking banishes all visible demons and imps in line-of-sight to Gehennom (or teleports them away if already in Gehennom).
Banishment success: 100% for standard demons/imps, 50% for Demon Lords, 33% for Demon Princes; wakes targets and cancels peacefulness.
Blocks demon gating while wielded.
First sacrifice gift for Priests.

name: Werebane
specialEffects: Confers complete immunity to contracting lycanthropy while wielded.
Safe for any alignment to touch and wield without blast damage UNLESS they're a lycanthrope.

name: Giantslayer
specialEffects: Confers steadfast while wielded on the ground, preventing the hero from being pushed back by monster blows.
Generates with base +2 enchantment.

name: Ogresmasher
specialEffects: Sets Constitution to 25 while wielded.
50% chance on any hit to knock the target back 1 or 2 squares (instead of 16.7%).
Safe for any alignment to touch and wield without blast damage.
Generates with base +2 enchantment.

name: Trollsbane
specialEffects: Permanently prevents slain trolls from reviving: corpses created by Trollsbane will never resurrect.
When wielded in the primary hand, off-hand weapon kills also prevent troll revival.
Confers regeneration while wielded (still subject to increased hunger while healing).
Safe for any alignment to touch and wield without blast damage.
Generates with base +2 enchantment.

name: Vorpal Blade
specialEffects: 5% Chance instantly decapitates and kills any corporeal creature with a head.
Has a guaranteed 100% chance on every hit to instantly decapitate and kill jabberwocks.
On a decapitation 'hit' against headless targets, misses wildly for 0 damage, while noncorporeal targets take normal damage.
Generates with base +1 enchantment.

name: Snickersnee
specialEffects: Applying Snickersnee allows one free polearm-style reach strike per turn up to 2 tiles away.
Unlike actual polearms, suffers no awkward close-range bashing penalty when unmounted in melee.
First sacrifice gift for lawful Samurai.

name: Sunsword
specialEffects: Emits permanent light (radius 3) while wielded without consuming fuel or oil.
Invoking shoots a beam of blinding light (blinds targets; bypasses cooldown for 25 Pw), or directed up/down permanently lights the floor tile.
Fully damages ethereal shades despite being non-silver.

name: The Orb of Detection
specialEffects: Invoking toggles Invisibility on and off at will.
For Archeologists only, failure check for applying the crystal ball drops to rnd(8) > Int (guaranteed if Int >= 8); never explodes for any hero.

name: The Heart of Ahriman
specialEffects: Invoking toggles levitation on and off; pressing > or dropping it while levitating descends the hero back to the ground.
Never breaks on impact when thrown as ammo.

name: The Sceptre of Might
specialEffects: Invoking toggles hungerless conflict on and off, and ends if it leaves the hero's inventory.

name: The Staff of Aesculapius
specialEffects: Every hit against non-drain-resistant monsters drains 1 monster level and reduces their maximum HP by 1d8.
The wielder is healed for half of the drained damage rounded up on every successful drain hit.
Invoking restores half of the hero's max HP, and completely purges and cures sickness, slime, and blindness.

name: The Magic Mirror of Merlin
specialEffects: While carried by a Knight, doubles damage dealt by offensive spells (force bolt, magic missile, drain life, chain lightning, Turn Undead, and basic fireball/cone of cold) as well as wands of striking and undead turning.
Unlike ordinary mirrors, it is indestructible and will never break or shatter when dropped, kicked, or thrown.
Whispers rumors when wielded or applied: guaranteed true if blessed, random if uncursed, and guaranteed false if cursed.

name: The Eyes of the Overworld
specialEffects: Grants x-ray vision with a radius of 3 squares while worn.
Completely suppresses blindness while worn.
Invoking grants enlightenment.

name: The Mitre of Holiness
specialEffects: While worn by a Priest, halves all incoming physical attack damage from undead, demons, and vampire shifters.
Can damage shades in combat due to its anti-undead property.
Invoking restores half of missing magical energy (up to +120 Pw), or all missing energy if less than 12 Pw is missing.

name: The Longbow of Diana
specialEffects: When wielded by a Ranger, grants +1 to the maximum multishot volley with any appropriate ammo.
Arrows shot from the bow do not deal double damage; the double damage modifier only applies when the bow itself is used as a melee bashing club.
Invoking spawns an uneroded stack of 6-11 arrows (matching the bow's beatitude, 1% chance poisoned), plus 1-10 extra arrows if blessed (7-21 total) or 1-5 extra arrows if uncursed (7-16 total).

name: The Master Key of Thievery
specialEffects: When carried (uncursed for Rogues, blessed for non-Rogues), #untrap on doors and containers has a 100% chance to detect traps and disarming them always succeeds with zero chance of triggering.
When wielded without gloves, senses adjacent traps in the 8 surrounding tiles by temperature (cool, warm, hot, or like fire!).
Whispers rumors when wielded or applied: guaranteed true if blessed, random if uncursed, and guaranteed false if cursed.
When used to pick a locked door or container that is trapped, immediately prompts to disarm the trap with a 100% success rate before unlocking.
Invoking triggers the untrap command in a targeted direction with guaranteed success.

name: The Tsurugi of Muramasa
specialEffects: Has a 5% chance on any hit to bisect small and medium monsters, killing them instantly.
Against large and giant monsters, a bisection roll deals double damage instead of instantly killing.
While engulfed, 5% chance of bisecting the insides of the engulfing monster for an instant kill.
Against long worms, a bisection roll to the head kills it instantly, while hits to the body trigger normal segment cutting.
Functions as a luckstone while carried.

name: The Platinum Yendorian Express Card
specialEffects: Invoking recharges a targeted wand, magic marker, ring, or tool in inventory: acts as a blessed recharge if blessed and used by a Tourist (granting a chance at maximum charges), an uncursed recharge if uncursed (or used by non-Tourists), and a cursed recharge if cursed.

name: The Orb of Fate
specialEffects: Invoking grants level teleportation, but still warrants the need for teleport control.
For Valkyries only, failure check for applying the crystal ball drops to rnd(8) > Int (guaranteed if Int >= 8); never explodes for any hero.
Functions as a luckstone while carried.

name: The Eye of the Aethiopica
specialEffects: Invoking opens a portal to any previously visited dungeon branch and teleports the hero directly there.
Teleports to the entrance of the branch if current depth is shallower than or equal to the branch start, or to the deepest reached level of that branch otherwise.
Cannot open a portal while carrying the Amulet of Yendor, while in or targeting the Endgame, within the same branch, or if adjacent spaces are blocked.
